records.process_description: Bachelor students complete a 15‑ECTS empirical Bachelorarbeit based on a quantitative data analysis. The Bachelorarbeitsmodul bildet den Betreuungsrahmen; die Arbeit wird angeleitet und moderiert durch die Dozierenden des Instituts (i.e., supervision is provided by institute lecturers). Registration, booking, submission and deadlines are not given on this page — you must follow the Philosophische Fakultät – Abschluss webpage for the formal Anmeldung, Fristen and submission procedures. Formal requirements noted here: independent empirical work with quantitative analysis; see the Merkblatt Bachelor‑Arbeit (PDF, Stand 09.01.2026). Official guidelines include the faculty Abschluss page and the Bachelor Studienordnung. Questions: programmkoordination@soziologie.uzh.ch or abschluss@phil.uzh.ch.
